meaning_or_distinction: Use at for a precise clock time.
notes: Noon and midnight remain separate lexical point expressions.

meaning_or_distinction: Use at with the named exact points noon and midnight.
notes: MW Learner's Dictionary.

meaning_or_distinction: Use at night for the general nighttime period.
notes: Cambridge Dictionary usage guidance.

meaning_or_distinction: Use during the night for something occurring within one particular night.
notes: Separate from the habitual/general at night decision.

meaning_or_distinction: Use no preposition before last night.
confusables: in last night; on last night
notes: Route is time phrase, not general zero-preposition grammar.

meaning_or_distinction: Use at the moment for the current point or short current period.
notes: In the moment has a different experiential meaning.

meaning_or_distinction: Use at the time for the relevant past or future point.
notes: Cambridge Dictionary.

meaning_or_distinction: Use at age plus a number for a life-stage point.
notes: AmE also permits at the age of 18.

meaning_or_distinction: Use at for a point in a process or development.
notes: Productive process-stage use.

meaning_or_distinction: Use on with a named weekday.
notes: Specific calendar dates remain a separate item.

meaning_or_distinction: Use on with a specific calendar date.
notes: Includes month-plus-date form.

meaning_or_distinction: Use on for a morning afternoon or evening linked to a particular day.
confusables: in Friday morning; at Friday morning
notes: Distinct from in the morning.

meaning_or_distinction: Use on when a holiday is treated as a particular day.
construction: on Thanksgiving Day; on New Year's Day
notes: Holiday expressions vary; this covers the day reading.

meaning_or_distinction: Use on for the day of a birthday.
notes: At a birthday party is place/event, not this item.

meaning_or_distinction: Use at with a holiday period treated as a season rather than a particular day.
confusables: on Christmas Day; during the holidays
notes: Specific holiday days normally take on.

meaning_or_distinction: Use in with months.
notes: MW Learner's Dictionary.

meaning_or_distinction: Use in with years.
notes: Includes in the 1990s as a separate decade form.

meaning_or_distinction: Use in with seasons; AmE permits forms such as in winter and in the winter.
notes: The article varies with context and is not a BrE/AmE binary.

meaning_or_distinction: Use in the with decades.
notes: Use the 1990s rather than 90's in formal writing.

meaning_or_distinction: Use in the with centuries.
notes: Productive historical-period pattern.

meaning_or_distinction: Use in the for a general part of a day.
notes: Friday morning takes on because it is day-linked.

meaning_or_distinction: Use in for how long from now until a future event.
confusables: for two weeks; after two weeks
notes: Core future-time distinction.

meaning_or_distinction: Use no preposition before last plus a time expression.
confusables: in last week; on last summer
notes: Cambridge learner grammar.

meaning_or_distinction: Use no preposition before next plus a time expression.
confusables: in next month; on next Friday
notes: Does not cover a next that means adjacent.

meaning_or_distinction: Use no preposition before this plus a time expression.
confusables: in this morning; on this year
notes: Time-use only.

meaning_or_distinction: Use no preposition before every or each plus a time noun.
confusables: on every Friday; in each year
notes: On every Friday has a marked contrastive reading; do not teach it as default.

meaning_or_distinction: Use no preposition before all plus a period.
confusables: for all day; during all day
notes: For all day is unnatural for the intended simple-duration reading; longer quantified contexts can differ.

meaning_or_distinction: Use on the weekend or on weekends in standard AmE.
notes: Keep chiefly BrE at the weekend out of the learner-facing AmE answer.

meaning_or_distinction: Use for to state duration.
confusables: in three hours; during three hours
notes: Core duration pattern.

meaning_or_distinction: Use during for something happening within a named event or period.
confusables: for the meeting; while the meeting
notes: During takes a noun phrase; while takes a clause.

meaning_or_distinction: Choose during before a noun phrase and while before a clause.
construction: during the review; while we reviewed
confusables: while the review; during we reviewed
notes: Construction-driven contrast.

meaning_or_distinction: Use over for an event or change distributed across a period.
confusables: for the past decade; during the past decade
notes: Often overlaps semantically; context must establish distribution/change.

meaning_or_distinction: Use throughout for something present or continuing during the whole period.
notes: Stronger whole-period meaning than during.

meaning_or_distinction: Use since for a starting point continuing to the reference time.
notes: Usually pairs with perfect aspect but tense teaching belongs elsewhere.

meaning_or_distinction: Use since plus a clause to name the event that began the period.
confusables: from I moved here; for I moved here
notes: Clause commonly uses past form.

meaning_or_distinction: Use from to state a start when the endpoint is stated or understood independently.
notes: Since foregrounds continuation to the reference time.

meaning_or_distinction: Use by for completion no later than an endpoint.
notes: Core deadline versus continuation decision.

meaning_or_distinction: Use until for an action or state continuing up to an endpoint.
notes: Till is conversational; until is neutral.

meaning_or_distinction: Use through when an activity includes the stated endpoint.
notes: AmE especially common for inclusive dates.

meaning_or_distinction: Use up to for a maximum amount or possible continuation limit.
confusables: until two hours; through two hours
notes: Meaning can be maximum rather than guaranteed duration.

target_form: from + starting time/date + to + ending time/date
meaning_or_distinction: Use from ... to for a temporal range with endpoints.
notes: Core temporal range; the explicitly inclusive through form remains separate.

meaning_or_distinction: Use through in AmE to include the final date in a date range.
notes: To may be understood inclusively; through makes inclusion explicit.

meaning_or_distinction: Use between ... and, not between ... to, for two endpoints.
notes: Common form error.

meaning_or_distinction: Use before for an earlier time or event.
notes: Neutral general form.

meaning_or_distinction: Use after for a later time or event.
notes: Neutral general form.

meaning_or_distinction: Use within for completion at some point no later than the end of a stated interval.
notes: Within measures from a reference point; in can state expected future timing.

meaning_or_distinction: Use ago after a duration to count backward from now/a stated reference point.
confusables: before two days; two days before
notes: Ago follows the amount; before can use another past reference point.

meaning_or_distinction: Use later after a duration to count forward from a stated reference point.
confusables: in two days; after two days
notes: Reference point must be recoverable.

meaning_or_distinction: Use prior to as a formal alternative to before.
notes: Preposition requires noun phrase or V-ing.

meaning_or_distinction: Use following as a formal after-like time relation before a noun.
notes: Adjective/participle use; keep to time relation.

meaning_or_distinction: Use on time for occurring at the scheduled or expected time.
notes: Core fixed-chunk contrast.

meaning_or_distinction: Use in time when there is enough time before a deadline or event.
construction: in time to catch the train
confusables: on time; in a timely manner
notes: Not simply a synonym for on time.

meaning_or_distinction: Use by the time plus a clause for completion before that clause's time.
construction: by the time the meeting starts
notes: Clause construction; tense selection is outside this inventory.

meaning_or_distinction: Use over time for change or development across a period.
notes: Overtime is a different word and meaning.

meaning_or_distinction: Use at times for sometimes or on some occasions.
notes: At times can imply a recurring tendency.

meaning_or_distinction: Use from time to time for occasional recurrence.
notes: Near-synonym but a fixed reusable chunk.

meaning_or_distinction: Use at when a location is viewed as a point or activity site.
construction: at the entrance; at the bus stop
confusables: in the entrance; on the bus stop
notes: Merriam-Webster and Cambridge learner references.

meaning_or_distinction: Use in for location inside an enclosed area or bounded space.
construction: in the room; in the park
confusables: at the room; on the room
notes: Core containment viewpoint.

meaning_or_distinction: Use on for contact with a surface.
construction: on the table; on the wall
confusables: in the table; at the wall
notes: Core surface viewpoint.

meaning_or_distinction: Use at home for being at one's residence.
notes: In the home can mean inside a particular household/building.

meaning_or_distinction: Use in the home when the interior of a home is the location or setting.
notes: Requires an interior/setting meaning.

meaning_or_distinction: Use at work for the workplace/activity status.
notes: At the office is a separate physical-site expression.

meaning_or_distinction: Use in to foreground the interior and at to frame the office as a work site; both often overlap.
construction: in the office; at the office
confusables: one form treated as universally wrong
notes: The Front must force a viewpoint or accept both.

meaning_or_distinction: Use at the office when the office is treated as a work site rather than its interior.
notes: Duplicate viewpoint decision merged into PLACE-IN-OFFICE.

meaning_or_distinction: Use at school for attendance or presence at the institution.
notes: In school often means enrolled in education, not physical location.

meaning_or_distinction: Use in school in AmE for being enrolled in or attending an educational program.
notes: Distinguish enrollment status from current site and a particular building.

meaning_or_distinction: Use in the school for a location inside a particular school building.
notes: The article identifies a particular building.

meaning_or_distinction: Use in for the building interior or patient state and at for the hospital site; both can overlap in AmE.
construction: in the hospital; at the hospital
confusables: one form treated as universally wrong
notes: Context must identify patient/interior/site viewpoint or accept both.

meaning_or_distinction: Use at the hospital for being at the site, often as visitor or worker.
notes: Duplicate viewpoint decision merged into PLACE-IN-HOSPITAL.

meaning_or_distinction: Use in prison for confinement as a prisoner.
notes: In the prison means inside a particular building.

meaning_or_distinction: Use in bed for resting or sleeping in bed.
notes: On the bed is physical surface location.

meaning_or_distinction: Use at to frame attendance at the event and in to foreground active participation or unavailability; both commonly overlap.
construction: at a meeting; in a meeting
confusables: one form treated as universally wrong
notes: The Front must force a viewpoint or accept both.

meaning_or_distinction: Use in a meeting to emphasize being engaged in the meeting.
notes: Duplicate viewpoint decision merged into PLACE-AT-MEETING.

meaning_or_distinction: Use at for attendance at an event.
construction: at a conference; at a concert
confusables: in a conference; on a concert
notes: In a conference may describe participation in a process, but not default.

meaning_or_distinction: Use at for a complete street address.
notes: AmE address form.

meaning_or_distinction: Use on for a location along a named street.
notes: At Main Street needs a point such as an intersection/stop.

meaning_or_distinction: Use at for the crossing point of streets.
confusables: in Main and First; on Main and First
notes: AmE coordinate-intersection convention.

meaning_or_distinction: Use on for a particular story/floor of a building.
notes: Also physical surface meaning; same retrieval form.

meaning_or_distinction: Use at for a point at an entrance or exit.
confusables: in the exit; on the exit
notes: Inside the entrance is a different interior meaning.

meaning_or_distinction: Use at for a transit stopping point.
construction: at the next stop; at Union Station
confusables: on the stop; in the station
notes: At a station is point/site; in the station is interior.

meaning_or_distinction: Use on a route for a position or service assigned to that route.
notes: Along the route is path-side location and belongs with path context.

meaning_or_distinction: Use in for cities countries states and regions.
notes: Core larger-area use.

target_form: on an island / on or in + island name
meaning_or_distinction: Use on for the physical landmass; with a named island, on and in can reflect landmass versus regional viewpoints.
confusables: one named-island form treated as universally wrong
notes: Require physical context for a single on answer; otherwise accept natural in.

meaning_or_distinction: Use on the coast for a location along a coastline.
confusables: in the coast; at the coast
notes: Merriam-Webster learner usage.

meaning_or_distinction: Use on the border for location at a boundary between areas.
notes: Merriam-Webster learner usage.

meaning_or_distinction: Use above for higher position; use over when directly higher or covering.
construction: above the door; over the table
notes: Overlap is context-sensitive; do not make an absolute distance rule.

meaning_or_distinction: Use below for lower position; use under when directly lower or covered by something.
construction: below the line; under the table
notes: Beneath is more formal/literary in many contexts.

meaning_or_distinction: Use between for a location relative to two distinct items.
construction: between the desk and the window
notes: Between can extend beyond two in some set relations; core spatial decision is two.

meaning_or_distinction: Use among for location within a group or mass of items.
notes: AmE prefers among in this general spatial use.

meaning_or_distinction: Use beside or next to for immediately at the side of something.
construction: beside the door; next to the door
notes: Treat both listed forms as accepted equivalents.

meaning_or_distinction: Use near or by for close location without necessarily touching.
construction: near the station; by the window
notes: Treat both as accepted; by often sounds less precise or more contextual.

meaning_or_distinction: Use opposite or across from for location facing another place across a space.
construction: opposite the bank; across from the bank
notes: Treat both listed forms as accepted; opposite without from is standard.

meaning_or_distinction: Use in front of for a forward position and behind for a rear position.
construction: in front of the building; behind it
notes: Before/after may be temporal rather than spatial.

meaning_or_distinction: Use inside for within a boundary and outside for beyond it.
construction: inside the gate; outside the gate
notes: Static location; movement forms belong in 03.

meaning_or_distinction: Use beyond for a location farther than or on the far side of a reference point.
notes: Past is usually movement/path in this deck.

meaning_or_distinction: Use at the edge of for the boundary point of an area or object.
construction: at the edge of the field
notes: On the edge can be natural for surface/balance context.

meaning_or_distinction: Use in the center/middle of for a position surrounded by an area.
notes: At the center is possible for an institutional center, different noun sense.

meaning_or_distinction: Use on top of for contact with the upper surface.
notes: At the top of is a point/position, not necessarily contact.

meaning_or_distinction: Use at the bottom of for the lowest point/area.
construction: at the bottom of the page
confusables: in the bottom of; on the bottom of
notes: On the bottom of is for contact with an underside/surface.

meaning_or_distinction: Use at the front/back of for a position at an end of a space or group.
construction: at the front of the line
notes: In front of is relative external position.

meaning_or_distinction: Use on for location aboard shared public transport.
construction: on the bus; on the train
confusables: in the bus; in the train
notes: Cambridge learner usage.

meaning_or_distinction: Use in for location inside a car or taxi.
construction: in the car; in a taxi
confusables: on the car; on a taxi
notes: On a motorcycle/bike is a separate vehicle form.

meaning_or_distinction: Use on for location riding a bike motorcycle or horse.
construction: on a bike; on a motorcycle
confusables: in a bike; in a motorcycle
notes: Cambridge learner usage.

meaning_or_distinction: Use on for content or activity located on a website.
notes: AmE default for websites/platforms.

meaning_or_distinction: Use in for content contained in a document or file.
construction: in the report; in the file
confusables: on the report; on the file
notes: On the report can mean written/printed on its surface or topic-specific uses.

meaning_or_distinction: Use on for text or marks located on a physical or displayed page.
notes: In the document is broader containment.

meaning_or_distinction: Use on for a service or platform where content/activity appears.
notes: In a Zoom meeting is a different event-participation form.

meaning_or_distinction: Use on a call for currently participating in a phone/video call.
notes: In a call is also natural in software-interface or status contexts; do not mark it universally wrong.

meaning_or_distinction: Use in a chat for content or participation within a chat conversation.
notes: On chat is not standard for the intended location.

meaning_or_distinction: Use in for active participation in a video/online meeting.
notes: On Zoom is platform use; in a meeting is event participation.

meaning_or_distinction: Use to for movement toward a destination.
confusables: at the office; toward the office
notes: Core destination form.

meaning_or_distinction: Use toward for orientation/direction without asserting arrival.
notes: Toward is more common in AmE than towards; both occur.

meaning_or_distinction: Use no to before home when home is the destination adverb.
notes: Productive destination-adverb pattern.

meaning_or_distinction: Use no to before here or there as a destination adverb.
confusables: come to here; go to there
notes: Movement-specific no-to pattern.

meaning_or_distinction: Use no to before downtown when it functions as a destination adverb.
notes: To downtown needs a following noun phrase in forms such as to downtown Chicago.

meaning_or_distinction: Use no to before abroad when it functions as a destination adverb.
notes: Separate lexical destination adverb from downtown.

meaning_or_distinction: Use arrive at for a point/small place and arrive in for a city/country/large area.
construction: arrive at the station; arrive in Boston
notes: AmE learner reference; size/viewpoint can be contextual.

meaning_or_distinction: Use no preposition before home when it follows arrive as a destination adverb.
confusables: arrive at home; arrive to home
notes: Arrive at home can occur when home is framed as a place, but arrive home is the core destination pattern.

meaning_or_distinction: Use reach with a direct object, not reach to, for arrival at a place.
notes: Duplicate direct-object decision routed to TRAP-DIRECT-REACH-DESTINATION.

meaning_or_distinction: Use return to before a destination noun.
notes: Return home is an exception with no to.

meaning_or_distinction: Use no to with return home.
notes: Movement-specific exception.

meaning_or_distinction: Use enter with a direct object, not enter into, for physical entry.
notes: Duplicate decision routed to TRAP-DIRECT-ENTER-PLACE under the one-home grammar-trap precedence.

meaning_or_distinction: Use approach with a direct object for moving nearer.
notes: Duplicate direct-object decision routed to TRAP-DIRECT-APPROACH.

meaning_or_distinction: Use from to name the starting point of movement.
notes: Out of adds boundary-exit meaning.

meaning_or_distinction: Use out of for movement from inside an enclosed space to outside it.
confusables: from the room; out the room
notes: Out can be adverbial without a following noun.

meaning_or_distinction: Use out without of when no following source noun is named.
notes: Out of requires a complement in this movement use.

meaning_or_distinction: Use off for movement away from a surface or off a vehicle.
confusables: out of the curb; from the curb
notes: Off a bus is transport-specific but same boundary relation.

meaning_or_distinction: Use away from for movement that increases distance from a source.
confusables: from the fire; off the fire
notes: From only identifies source; away from adds separation direction.

meaning_or_distinction: Use into for movement from outside to inside.
confusables: in the room; to the room
notes: Core static in versus directional into contrast.

meaning_or_distinction: Use into for movement that results in contact/collision with an object.
confusables: on a wall; against a wall
notes: Against can emphasize force/contact rather than crossing boundary.

meaning_or_distinction: Use onto for movement ending on a surface.
confusables: on the roof; to the roof
notes: On is static location; to may omit surface relation.

meaning_or_distinction: Use get off for leaving a bus train plane or similar transport.
notes: Get out of is normal for cars/taxis.

meaning_or_distinction: Use get in or get into for entering a car or taxi.
notes: In and into are both normal with motion; into stresses entry.

meaning_or_distinction: Use get on to board public transport.
notes: Also applies to bike/motorcycle with riding context.

meaning_or_distinction: Use get out of to leave a car or taxi.
notes: Get off is normal for larger public transport.

meaning_or_distinction: Use across for movement from one side to the other across an open area/surface.
confusables: through the street; along the street
notes: Cross can take a direct object; that is a separate verb pattern.

meaning_or_distinction: Use through for movement within and from one side of an enclosed or bounded space to another.
confusables: across the tunnel; along the tunnel
notes: Boundary/interior path is central.

meaning_or_distinction: Use along for movement following the length of a line or route.
confusables: across the river; through the river
notes: Also static location possible; movement context required.

meaning_or_distinction: Use past for movement beyond a reference point without stopping there.
confusables: to the library; beyond the library
notes: Beyond can be static; past is common motion path form.

meaning_or_distinction: Use around for a path that avoids passing through or over an obstacle.
confusables: through the barrier; over the barrier
notes: Context must force the bypass path.

meaning_or_distinction: Use around for movement in various parts of an area or along a surrounding path.
confusables: through the neighborhood; across the neighborhood
notes: Context must distinguish roaming within from circling the boundary when relevant.

meaning_or_distinction: Use over for movement across and above an obstacle or from one side to the other.
confusables: across the fence; above the fence
notes: Across may work for a bridge/open surface, not this obstacle relation.

meaning_or_distinction: Use under for movement below an obstacle.
confusables: below the table; through the table
notes: Below is static vertical position.

meaning_or_distinction: Use up for upward movement along a route or surface.
confusables: to the stairs; on the stairs
notes: Upstairs is an adverb and takes no to.

meaning_or_distinction: Use down for downward movement along a route or surface.
confusables: to the hill; on the hill
notes: Downstairs is an adverb and takes no to.

meaning_or_distinction: Use no to before upstairs or downstairs as destination adverbs.
confusables: go to upstairs; come to downstairs
notes: Movement-specific no-to pattern.

meaning_or_distinction: Use leave with a direct object for departing a place.
confusables: leave from the office; leave out of the office
notes: Leave from is possible for scheduled departure origin; distinguish if needed later.

meaning_or_distinction: Use for to name the destination toward which someone departs.
confusables: leave from + source; leave to + place
notes: Complements the separate leave-from source pattern.

meaning_or_distinction: Use depart from to state an origin in formal/travel contexts.
notes: Leave Gate 4 can also naturally describe a departure; do not force depart from when both fit.

meaning_or_distinction: Use head to for deliberate movement toward a destination.
notes: Toward stresses direction and does not entail arrival.

meaning_or_distinction: Use come from for origin or source.
confusables: come out of Peru; come to Peru
notes: Physical emergence from a container uses out of.

meaning_or_distinction: Use back to for return movement to a named destination.
confusables: return back to work; go back work
notes: Return already includes back; avoid return back in standard edited English.

meaning_or_distinction: Names the person or organization that performs a passive action.
notes: Keep distinct from by + method.

meaning_or_distinction: Names the tool or material used to do an action.
Names the method used to achieve a result.
Names a process, effort, or mechanism through which a result is achieved.
Names an intermediary route or communication channel.
Names a communication medium in compact expressions.
notes: Payment method is covered only by VP-PAY-BY.

meaning_or_distinction: Names a resource or quality used to accomplish an action.
Identifies the source or cause from which a condition develops.
confusables: because of + cause; due to + cause
notes: Do not use suffer/recover/die examples; their selected frames belong to 05.

meaning_or_distinction: Attributes an outcome to a process, circumstance, or lack of care.
States the reason for a decision, action, or feeling.
confusables: because of + cause; for the purpose of
notes: Do not use apologize or punish examples; those selected frames belong to 05.

meaning_or_distinction: Names where a person, thing, information, or material originates.
Use for + V-ing for what a thing is for; use to + base verb for why an agent acts.
construction: noun + for + V-ing; verb + to + base verb
confusables: for + V-ing for personal purpose; so that + clause
notes: One contrast decision; infinitival to is not itself a preposition.

meaning_or_distinction: States why an agent acts or why something exists.
notes: Covered by AR-PURPOSE-FOR as the paired purpose contrast.

meaning_or_distinction: Names the person expected or able to perform an action.
Names who receives the benefit or for whom something is intended.
Names the receiver of a transfer, message, or direction.
Names what is received, paid, or substituted in exchange.
notes: Rerouted to VP-EXCHANGE-FOR because this is a verb-selected frame.

meaning_or_distinction: States a listed, offered, or set price/rate.
Names the general subject of speech, thought, or information.
notes: Verb-selected talk about is not separately inventoried in 05.

meaning_or_distinction: Names the subject of a formal document, presentation, or focused discussion.
Introduces the matter being referred to in professional writing.
notes: Concerning is an accepted formal synonym; do not force a contrast.

meaning_or_distinction: Introduces a topic that is the subject of a formal statement.
notes: Regarding is an accepted formal synonym; do not force a contrast.

meaning_or_distinction: Places a claim, skill, or change within an area or respect.
Expresses resemblance to a person or thing.
States the role, job, or capacity in which someone/something acts.
Introduces comparison with a clause or degree pattern.
notes: Keep role and comparison senses separate.

meaning_or_distinction: Marks a direct difference from a comparison point.
States that something happens although a fact might suggest otherwise.
Excludes an item from a stated group or rule.
Means except after negative or limiting expressions.
Adds another relevant item or reason.
Names a part or component of a larger whole.
Use made of when the original material remains recognizable; use made from when it has been transformed.
Uses a material that has been transformed into the final object.
notes: Covered by AR-MATERIAL-OF as the paired material contrast.

meaning_or_distinction: Names an added feature, ingredient, or accompanying content.
Expresses possession or part-whole relation in an of-phrase.
notes: Too broad for one retrieval decision; add a specific high-value chunk later only if a genuine gap remains.

meaning_or_distinction: Names the author, artist, or creator of a work.
States a measured level, speed, temperature, or rate.
States the amount of increase, decrease, or difference.
States the endpoint reached after a numerical change.

target_form: from + starting value + to + ending value
meaning_or_distinction: States the endpoints of a numerical range or change.
notes: Distinct from the temporal range item in 01 Time.

meaning_or_distinction: States a rate for each unit of time, distance, or quantity.
States the age at which an event occurs.
notes: Duplicate of TIME-AT-AGE; time meanings route to 01 Time.

meaning_or_distinction: States a proportion, quantity, or measurement belonging to a total.
Describes exposure to possible harm or loss.

meaning_or_distinction: Names the person or group directing a situation.
notes: Covered by AR-CONTROL-UNDER as the paired control contrast.

meaning_or_distinction: Describes the condition or circumstance in which something exists.
notes: Too broad for one retrieval decision; add a specific high-value chunk later only if a genuine gap remains.

meaning_or_distinction: Requires a factor, person, or condition for an outcome.
Trust or need someone or something for support or performance.
Informally rely on someone or expect something to happen.
Help cause or help produce a result.
Cause or make an outcome likely to happen.

target_form: result in + outcome / result from + cause
meaning_or_distinction: Use result in for an outcome and result from for its cause.
construction: result in + noun/V-ing; result from + noun/V-ing

meaning_or_distinction: Be caused by a particular source or event.
notes: Covered by VP-RESULT-IN as the paired result/cause contrast.

meaning_or_distinction: Originate in or be caused by a source.
notes: Broadly useful formal/academic item.

meaning_or_distinction: Develop from a situation, issue, or cause.
Have an effect on a person, system, or outcome.
notes: AmE also permits impact as a transitive verb; explain in card.

meaning_or_distinction: Explain a cause, share, or amount.
notes: Split into VP-ACCOUNT-FOR-EXPLAIN and VP-ACCOUNT-FOR-SHARE.

meaning_or_distinction: Take part in an activity or process.

notes: Common in professional English.

meaning_or_distinction: means following a rule, agreement, or standard
notes: Use broadly applicable regulatory or procedural contexts.

meaning_or_distinction: means appropriate to or consistent with a character or tradition
notes: Audit usefulness against in line with.

meaning_or_distinction: means incompatible or in active disagreement with something
notes: Useful for policies, goals, evidence, and interests.

meaning_or_distinction: means in disagreement or incompatible with something
notes: Fixed plural odds must remain intact.

meaning_or_distinction: means together or in combination with something
notes: Excluded in Phase 2: lower-value formal synonym; covered by in combination with.

meaning_or_distinction: indicates cooperative work with another party
notes: Keep human or organizational collaborator complement.

meaning_or_distinction: indicates organized involvement or partnership
notes: Excluded in Phase 2: lower-value formal synonym; covered by in collaboration with.

meaning_or_distinction: means as a representative of or for the benefit of another party
notes: On behalf of is the standard broad AmE target.

meaning_or_distinction: means using another's authority or claiming a stated principle as justification
notes: Excluded in Phase 2: lower-value formal synonym; covered by on behalf of.

meaning_or_distinction: attributes an action, quality, or responsibility to a party
notes: Excluded in Phase 2: lower-value formal synonym; covered by a direct by-phrase.

meaning_or_distinction: means because a particular person asked for it
notes: Distinguish at someone's request from available on request.

meaning_or_distinction: identifies evidence, criteria, or grounds used for a decision
notes: Article the is part of the expression.

meaning_or_distinction: identifies the method or instrument used
notes: Excluded in Phase 2: lower-value formal synonym; covered by by and with.

meaning_or_distinction: identifies the intended objective of an action
confusables: with a view to; in order to
notes: Excluded in Phase 2: lower-value formal synonym; covered by for the purpose of and in order to.

meaning_or_distinction: identifies the intended use or objective
confusables: for the purposes of; in order to
notes: Separate goal from scope-defining plural purposes.

meaning_or_distinction: indicates approval, advocacy, or evidence favoring something
notes: Can describe either advocacy or evidential support.

meaning_or_distinction: indicates organized or explicit disagreement
notes: Prepositional to requires a complement.

meaning_or_distinction: indicates support or preference for an option
confusables: in support of; favor + direct object
notes: American spelling favor.

meaning_or_distinction: identifies what is received or given as the other side of an exchange
confusables: in return for; exchange A for B
notes: Keep noun phrase distinct from verb exchange pattern.

meaning_or_distinction: means causing harm to or sacrificing one priority for another
confusables: at a cost to; instead of
notes: High-value trade-off expression.

meaning_or_distinction: means actively trying to achieve or obtain something
notes: Excluded in Phase 2: lower-value formal synonym; covered by pursue + direct object.

meaning_or_distinction: means for the benefit or protection of a person, goal, or principle
confusables: in the interest of; for the sake of
notes: Excluded in Phase 2: lower-value formal synonym; covered by for the sake of.

meaning_or_distinction: introduces the speaker's viewpoint
confusables: in my perspective; according to me
notes: Also productive with institutional or disciplinary perspectives.

meaning_or_distinction: introduces a personal opinion
confusables: from my perspective; according to me
notes: No article before possessive.

meaning_or_distinction: frames an issue from a particular person's or discipline's viewpoint
notes: Excluded in Phase 2: lower-value formal synonym; covered by from my perspective.

meaning_or_distinction: qualifies a statement as limited to what the speaker knows
notes: Do not use as a claim of absolute certainty.

meaning_or_distinction: indicates that something is partly but not completely true
notes: Broadly reusable hedging expression.

meaning_or_distinction: indicates partial truth or effect
notes: Excluded in Phase 2: duplicate partial-degree decision; retain to some extent.

meaning_or_distinction: means generally but not entirely
notes: Useful in general and academic contexts.

meaning_or_distinction: means theoretically, according to a rule, or as a general idea
notes: Contrast practical implementation where relevant.

meaning_or_distinction: distinguishes actual operation from an ideal or conceptual account
notes: One coherent contrast decision.

meaning_or_distinction: means according to a written plan or theory rather than actual performance
notes: Explain literal versus figurative meaning through context.

meaning_or_distinction: distinguishes a broad statement from a specific focus
notes: May be excluded if judged a pure discourse-marker decision.

meaning_or_distinction: means when particular conditions apply
notes: Excluded in Phase 2: in/under certain circumstances overlap; no stable retrieval contrast. Retain under no circumstances.

meaning_or_distinction: means in no possible situation
notes: Clause inversion after fronting belongs to a separate grammar module.

meaning_or_distinction: means if a specified event occurs
notes: Common in instructions and contingency planning.

meaning_or_distinction: means if a specified event occurs
confusables: in case + clause; in the event of
notes: Teach noun complement versus in case followed by a clause.

meaning_or_distinction: means when a person, thing, or evidence is not present
notes: Useful in academic and professional contexts.

meaning_or_distinction: means when a person, substance, or condition is present
notes: Productive in social, scientific, and technical contexts.

target_form: in the short term vs in the long term
meaning_or_distinction: distinguishes near-term from extended consequences
construction: in the short term; in the long term
confusables: over the short term; short-term adjective
notes: Keep term singular in these fixed phrases.

meaning_or_distinction: means temporarily until circumstances change
notes: Useful general-English time expression.

meaning_or_distinction: means during the period before another event happens
notes: Distinguish simultaneous interval from temporary state.

meaning_or_distinction: with little time to prepare or respond
notes: Use AmE target on short notice; BrE comparison need not appear on learner card.

meaning_or_distinction: describes change or activity throughout an extended period
notes: Useful for describing trends and processes.

meaning_or_distinction: means during an activity or process
notes: Audit whether contrast merits a separate item.

meaning_or_distinction: in danger of experiencing a harmful outcome
confusables: at the risk of; risk + V-ing
notes: At the risk of saying is a separate discourse expression and should not be merged.

meaning_or_distinction: experiencing demands to take an action
confusables: pressure on someone to; under pressure from
notes: Infinitival to is part of the following complement, not a preposition.

meaning_or_distinction: introduces a mean or typical value
notes: Common Mandarin-transfer target.

meaning_or_distinction: time before a scheduled event or deadline
notes: Distinguish complemented form from adverbial in advance.

meaning_or_distinction: talk about or examine a topic
notes: Merriam-Webster marks discuss transitive for this meaning.

meaning_or_distinction: go or come into a place
notes: Enter into is valid for agreements, discussions, and states; context must be physical place.

meaning_or_distinction: arrive at or get as far as a destination
notes: Canonical home for the direct-object destination rule; reach to has other meanings.

meaning_or_distinction: conclude or achieve an agreement or decision
confusables: reach to an agreement; arrive at an agreement
notes: Distinct collocational object from physical destination.

meaning_or_distinction: refer briefly to a topic
notes: May also take a content clause; central trap is extra about.

meaning_or_distinction: move nearer to or begin dealing with a person, place, or issue
confusables: approach to as a verb; an approach to as a noun
notes: Canonical direct-object rule; contrast verb with noun an approach to.

meaning_or_distinction: communicate with a person or organization
confusables: contact with as a verb; be in contact with
notes: Noun/adjective expression in contact with remains valid.

meaning_or_distinction: ask formally for something
confusables: request for as a verb; make a request for
notes: Contrast verb request with noun a request for.

meaning_or_distinction: give special importance to a point
notes: Contrast verb with noun phrase emphasis on.

meaning_or_distinction: think carefully about an option or possibility
notes: V-ing is a direct complement, not governed by a preposition.

meaning_or_distinction: describe the characteristics of something
confusables: describe about; give a description of
notes: Recipient pattern describe something to someone is separate below.

meaning_or_distinction: make an idea or situation clear
confusables: explain about; give an explanation of
notes: Some intransitive explain about contexts exist; use an unambiguous direct-object Front.

meaning_or_distinction: name the content directly and introduce the recipient with to
confusables: explain someone something; tell someone something
notes: Central error is omitted to before recipient.

meaning_or_distinction: name the thing directly and introduce the recipient with to
notes: Do not confuse the described person with the recipient.

meaning_or_distinction: respond to a person or thing by giving an answer
notes: Answer to is valid in other meanings such as be accountable to; context must be a question.

meaning_or_distinction: be present at an event
notes: Attend to means deal with or care for and is a different construction.

meaning_or_distinction: become a member or accompany a person
notes: Join in an activity and join with someone for a purpose remain valid.

meaning_or_distinction: become the spouse of someone
notes: Contrast active marry someone with be/get married to someone.

meaning_or_distinction: be similar in appearance or character
notes: Contrast verb resemble with adjective similar to.

meaning_or_distinction: not have enough of something
confusables: lack of as a verb; a lack of
notes: Contrast verb lack with noun a lack of.

meaning_or_distinction: disagree with or resist a proposal or action
notes: Contrast active verb with adjective/passive be opposed to.

meaning_or_distinction: deal with or give attention to a problem
notes: Address a message to someone is a different valid construction.

target_form: comprise + parts; be comprised of + parts
meaning_or_distinction: Uses active comprise for a whole that includes parts; recognizes be comprised of as common but usage-sensitive.
construction: whole + comprises + parts; whole + is comprised of + parts
confusables: comprise of; consist of; be composed of
notes: Do not mark be comprised of ungrammatical. Prefer consist of or be composed of where a conservative formal style is required.

meaning_or_distinction: affect a person, process, or decision
confusables: influence on as a verb; have an influence on
notes: Contrast verb with noun influence on.

meaning_or_distinction: produce a change in something
confusables: affect on; have an effect on
notes: Contrast verb affect with noun effect on.

meaning_or_distinction: wait for an expected person, event, or result
notes: Await is formal; include for recognition and useful writing.

meaning_or_distinction: go with or occur together with someone or something
notes: With may introduce an instrument in other accompany constructions; use person companion context.

meaning_or_distinction: do what a person or rule requires
notes: Contrast obey a rule with comply with a rule.

meaning_or_distinction: try to obtain or find something
notes: Seek is somewhat formal but broadly useful; seek out remains valid.

meaning_or_distinction: meet or experience unexpectedly
confusables: encounter with as a verb; have an encounter with
notes: Contrast verb with noun an encounter with.

meaning_or_distinction: confront or need to deal with a situation
confusables: face with as active verb; be faced with
notes: Contrast active face with passive/adjectival be faced with.

meaning_or_distinction: present something for the first time
confusables: introduce about; give an introduction to
notes: Person-recipient pattern introduce someone to someone is different.

meaning_or_distinction: cause a person to meet another or make someone familiar with something
notes: Central required-to construction.

target_form: say something to someone vs tell someone something
meaning_or_distinction: distinguishes recipient marking after say from direct recipient after tell
construction: say + content + to + person; tell + person + content
notes: One coherent complement-pattern contrast.

meaning_or_distinction: a preposition normally introduces a noun phrase as its complement
notes: A generic NP-complement label is not a card and because of already has the correct home in 08.

meaning_or_distinction: requires me/him/her/us/them rather than subject forms
notes: High-value general case rule.

meaning_or_distinction: uses object pronouns after between
notes: Fixed common error merits a concrete card.

meaning_or_distinction: uses myself/yourself/etc. when the complement refers back to the clause subject
confusables: for me vs for myself; by me vs by myself
notes: Context must distinguish reflexive identity from ordinary object pronoun and alone meaning.

meaning_or_distinction: uses the gerund-participial form when a verb follows a preposition
notes: The generic claim is not atomically testable; do not create a duplicate without + V-ing decision.

meaning_or_distinction: expresses the method used to achieve a result
notes: Duplicate decision already covered by AR-METHOD-BY-ING; its card must teach the V-ing complement.

meaning_or_distinction: expresses absence of an accompanying action
notes: Useful productive complement pattern.

meaning_or_distinction: expresses sequence with a nonfinite action sharing the understood subject
notes: Finite clause alternative is valid; teach construction choice rather than mark it wrong.

target_form: prepositional to + noun/V-ing vs infinitival to + base verb
meaning_or_distinction: distinguishes two grammatical functions of to
construction: to as preposition + complement; to as infinitive marker + base verb
confusables: to + base after a prepositional expression
notes: Requires concrete paired patterns on the card.

target_form: used to + base verb vs be/get used to + noun/V-ing
meaning_or_distinction: distinguishes past habit from familiarity
construction: used to + verb; be/get used to + complement
notes: Classic high-value to distinction.

meaning_or_distinction: uses prepositional to before the anticipated event
notes: Potential overlap with Verb + Preposition; route here because complement-form error is the decision.

meaning_or_distinction: uses prepositional to before a goal, policy, or continuing action
notes: Potential overlap with adjective combinations; retain for routing audit.

meaning_or_distinction: uses prepositional to before the thing opposed
notes: Canonical home for the prepositional-to complement error; VP-OBJECT-TO is excluded.

meaning_or_distinction: uses natural preposition stranding in ordinary questions
notes: Teach neutral stranded question beside formal fronting; never repair a sentence-final preposition merely because it is final.

meaning_or_distinction: fronts a preposition before whom in formal style
confusables: who after fronted preposition; ordinary stranded form
notes: Compare natural neutral form without treating it as wrong.

target_form: Where are you? / Where are you at?
meaning_or_distinction: Uses Where are you? as neutral AmE; recognizes Where are you at? as conversational and regionally variable, not ungrammatical.
construction: where + be + subject; conversational where + be + subject + at
confusables: treating sentence-final at as an error
notes: Do not use a repair prompt. Keep the locative and the idiom where someone is at distinct in examples.

target_form: relative clause ... preposition at clause end
meaning_or_distinction: uses natural stranding in neutral defining relative clauses
notes: Common productive pattern.

target_form: preposition + whom/which in a relative clause
meaning_or_distinction: uses formal preposition fronting before whom or which
notes: Cambridge confirms formal fronting and neutral stranding contrast.

meaning_or_distinction: prevents invalid fronting of a preposition before relative that
notes: That requires stranding if used as complement of a preposition.

target_form: omitted object relative pronoun + stranded preposition
meaning_or_distinction: allows omission of the relative pronoun when it is the complement of a stranded preposition
confusables: omission with fronted preposition; omission of subject relative pronoun
notes: Use defining relative clause only.

target_form: turn on the light / turn the light on
meaning_or_distinction: Allows a noun object on either side of the particle in this separable phrasal verb.
construction: turn + particle + noun; turn + noun + particle
notes: Use one separable carrier; do not claim all particles are separable.

meaning_or_distinction: requires a pronoun object before the particle in a separable phrasal verb
notes: Example pattern such as look it up; do not turn deck into phrasal-verb inventory.

meaning_or_distinction: Keeps the object after the preposition in the prepositional verb rely on.
notes: Cross-reference the 05 anchor; contrast only the placement decision.

meaning_or_distinction: keeps both particle and preposition before the object
notes: Use a broadly useful pattern such as put up with; exclude lexical expansion.

target_form: go out / go out of + place
meaning_or_distinction: Distinguishes an intransitive particle use from a preposition introducing an object.
construction: go out; go out of + noun
confusables: assuming every short word requires an object
notes: Use the same lexical carrier so the object requirement is observable.

meaning_or_distinction: To is infinitival after opportunity when it names the action possible.
notes: Infinitival to, not a noun + preposition combination.

meaning_or_distinction: To is infinitival after ability when it names the action possible.
notes: Infinitival to, not a noun + preposition combination.
